name: Land Cruiser HDJ81
notes: Confirmed real via VINs and OEM parts catalogs (distinct from HDJ80 in Toyota's own model-code system), but NOT independently corroborated by Wikipedia's J80 article, which only names HDJ80R. Best-supported theory: a JDM/Europe-market code for the same generation, not a different wheelbase or later facelift. Spans both the 1HD-T (1990-95) and 1HD-FT (1995-97) engine eras - mapped here to the already-seeded 1HD-T for simplicity. Treat as effectively the same drivetrain family as HDJ80 unless JDM-specific trim distinctions matter to you.
